name: Tray surfaces
responsibility: Draws a frame's neutral recessed well and the raised tab on its edge, inside one closed outline
description: A container and a sequence frame use the same top-lit tray. Its floor is neutral and a nested tray is deeper. The well has one top edge and one inner shadow across its whole width, under the tab too. One closed path goes round the tab and the well, and the tab's left side is the well's. A tray casts no shadow.
